en: Midnight. The Temple wall.
A shadow crosses the wall. Then another. And a third, smaller one, that hesitates before jumping.
Inside, the disciples' dormitory.
Twenty mats in a row. Nineteen disciples asleep.
Surround. Wait. Close. Surround. Wait. Close…
Three days until the novices' trial. If I pass, I get my staff.
*(asleep)* Ren… switch that head off. I can hear you thinking from here.
Gon sleeps like a rock. I never sleep the night before anything.
The sliding door opens without a sound.
Playing from memory again?
Master! No… I couldn't sleep.
Good. Tonight I need you awake.
Abbot Hōshin has seen seventy winters, and his voice has never trembled. Tonight, his hands do.
And there's grey dust on his sleeves. Where is he coming from at this hour?
Someone jumped the wall. Go see who dares.
Me? Shouldn't we wake Master Mei?
Mei has another watch tonight. And no one else needs to wake up.
Why?
Because a Temple that shouts at night is a Temple that's afraid. And we are not afraid.
If it's one, you're enough.
If there are more… don't shout. Come back for me.
Yes, Master.
Ren came to the Temple wrapped in a blanket, on a night of grey rain. It was the Abbot who lifted him from the step.
Sixteen years later, the blanket is still folded at the bottom of his trunk. He never learned who wove it.
He's looked after me my whole life. Tonight it's my turn.
zh: 一道黑影翻过寺墙。接着又是一道。还有第三道，小一些，跳之前犹豫了一下。
二十张草席排成一列。十九个弟子在熟睡。
围住。等待。合拢。围住。等待。合拢……
再过三天就是沙弥试炼。过了，我就能领到棍子。
*（睡梦中）*仁……把你那脑袋关了。我在这儿都听得见你在想事。
刚睡得像块石头。每逢大事前一晚，我都睡不着。
正好。今晚我需要你醒着。
法真方丈已历七十个寒冬，声音从未颤抖过。今晚，他的手在抖。
袖子上还沾着灰色的尘。这个时辰，他是从哪儿回来的？
有人翻墙进来了。去看看是谁这么大胆。
梅今晚另有守夜的差事。其他人谁也不必醒。
因为夜里大喊大叫的寺院，是心怀恐惧的寺院。而我们不怕。
若不止一个……别喊。回来找我。
仁是裹着一条毯子来到寺里的，那是一个下着灰雨的夜晚。是方丈亲手把他从台阶上抱起来的。
十六年过去，那条毯子仍叠放在他的箱底。他始终不知道是谁织的。
他照顾了我一辈子。今晚轮到我了。

en: The wall, a moment later.
Stop! Don't run!
You fight well for someone barefoot, little monk.
What did you come to steal?
Nothing. I came to leave something.
The ninja leaps, and the night swallows him.
Leave something?
On the wall's stone there's a fresh mark, drawn in charcoal: six dots around one.
Like a Leader surrounded on the board…
No. I've seen this somewhere else.
Later. The dormitory.
Nineteen disciples asleep. Ren opens his trunk without a sound.
In one corner of the blanket, stitched in grey thread, is a design he's seen a thousand times without ever really looking.
Six dots around one.
…Who stitched it?
And why would a ninja leave the same design on our wall?
zh: 光着脚还挺能打嘛，小和尚。
什么也不偷。我是来留下点东西的。
忍者一跃，便被夜色吞没。
墙石上有一个新画的印记，是用木炭画的：六个点围着一个点。
就像棋盘上被围住的首领……
十九个弟子在熟睡。仁悄无声息地打开箱子。
毯子一角，用灰线绣着一个图案。他看过上千次，却从没认真看过。
为什么一个忍者会在我们墙上留下同样的图案？

en: Morning. The training yard.
The sun beats down on the wooden posts. In the yard, no one talks about anything else: last night, ninjas got into the Temple.
Ren! Did you hear?
Hear what?
I caught a scout in the forest at dawn. All by myself.
By yourself? And that bandaged arm?
…I fell. Chasing him.
Gon never falls.
Heard yours got away.
He jumped the wall. I didn't make it.
I know. The whole Temple knows.
This time the Abbot congratulated me.
You earned it, Gon. Really.
Two words, he gave me. “Well done.” He'd have given Ren ten.
And no one can know where I was before dawn.
Enough chatter.
Before he's questioned, the Abbot wants to see how Ren fights him.
Ren? I'm the one who caught him!
That's why you rest today. With that arm, besides.
They bring in the prisoner, wrists bound. He's the age of an older brother, with the smile of someone who isn't afraid.
It's the one from the wall. The one who left the mark.
With his hands tied he can't use Kawarimi. Fight fair anyway, Ren.
Tied up and all, I'll still beat you, little monk.
Sleep well? I didn't. Your cells leak.
zh: 阳光照在木桩上。院子里人人都在议论同一件事：昨夜有忍者闯进了寺院。
天亮时我在林子里抓到一个斥候。就我一个人。
你一个人？那胳膊上的绷带怎么回事？
他只跟我说了两个字。“很好。”换作仁，他能说上十句。
而且谁也不能知道，天亮前我在哪儿。
审问之前，方丈想看看仁跟他交手如何。
所以今天你休息。何况你那条胳膊。
囚犯被押了上来，双手被绑。他像个兄长的年纪，脸上挂着无所畏惧的笑。
是墙上那个。留下印记的那个。
手被绑着，他用不了替身术。你还是要堂堂正正地打，仁。
就算绑着，我也赢得了你，小和尚。
睡得好吗？我可没睡好。你们的牢房漏雨。

en: The yard, at noon.
Good. You surround patiently. That's what matters.
Master, why do we always surround?
Why not just strike? It'd be faster.
I asked my master the same question. I was your age.
And what did she say?
“Because that's how we were taught.”
That's not an answer.
No. It isn't.
She died without answering it. I promised myself I wouldn't do the same.
And here I am. Doing the same.
I'd never seen her lower her eyes.
In the clan we surround too, you know.
You do?
My grandmother said it isn't a fight. It's a prayer.
A prayer to whom?
She never said. She died last winter, coughing.
She coughed grey, little monk. Like ash.
The mark on the wall. Six dots around one. What does it mean?
Where else have you seen it?
He asked that too fast.
I'll make you a trade. You tell me where you saw it, and I'll tell you what I came for.
Ren. We don't bargain with prisoners.
Think it over. Tonight they bring me cold rice. If you want, bring it yourself.
zh: 很好。你包围得很有耐心。这才是关键。
师父，我们为什么总是包围？
为什么不直接出手？那样更快。
我也问过我师父同样的问题。那时我跟你一般大。
她到死都没回答。我向自己发誓，绝不像她那样。
我从没见过她垂下眼睛。
我们族里也包围，你知道吗？
我奶奶说那不是打斗。是祈祷。
她从没说过。她去年冬天走了，是咳着走的。
她咳出来的是灰色的，小和尚。像灰烬。
墙上的印记。六个点围着一个点。那是什么意思？
跟你做个交易。你告诉我在哪儿见过，我告诉你我来干什么。
考虑一下。今晚他们会给我送冷饭。你愿意的话，就你来送。

en: That afternoon. The road to the village.
Ren heads down to the village for rice. The empty basket bumps against his back.
“Where else have you seen it?” He asked like his life depended on it.
A grandmother who coughed ash. Grey dust on the Master's sleeves. A mark on the wall, and on my blanket.
None of it makes sense. And all of it rhymes.
So quiet…
Not a bird. Not the wind. The forest holds its breath.
Three shadows drop from the trees. Before they touch the ground, they've surrounded him.
It's him. The Abbot's disciple.
You know me?
The whole clan knows the blanket boy.
…The blanket.
What do you know about my blanket?
That it's worth exactly one captured scout.
We're taking you to the pagoda. Tomorrow the Temple gives us back Sora, and you go home.
Sora? Is that his name?
Without hurting him. The Shogun was clear.
The Shogun doesn't know we're here. Surround him!
zh: 那天下午。去村子的路上。
仁下山去村里买米。空篮子拍打着他的背。
“你还在哪儿见过？”他问得像是性命攸关。
一个咳出灰烬的奶奶。师父袖子上的灰尘。墙上的印记，还有我毯子上的。
这些都说不通。可每一件都彼此相像。
没有鸟叫。没有风声。整片树林屏住了呼吸。
三道黑影从树上落下。还没落地，就已将他围住。
全族都认识那个裹毯子的孩子。
你们知道我毯子的什么事？
知道它正好值一个被抓的斥候。
我们带你去宝塔。明天寺院把空还给我们，你就能回家。
别伤着他。将军说得很清楚。
将军不知道我们在这儿。围住他！

en: The road, at sunset.
Why doesn't your Shogun want me hurt?
What's this about the blanket boy? Answer me!
I'm not the one you should be asking.
Ask the old man what he keeps down below. And what he found on the step sixteen years ago.
Down below?
The basket lies overturned. The rice is scattered across the road.
Three ninjas defy their Shogun for one scout.
I'll gather it anyway. If no one brings him dinner, I will.
zh: 你们将军为什么不让人伤我？
“裹毯子的孩子”是什么意思？回答我！
去问那个老头，他在下面藏了什么。还有十六年前，他在台阶上捡到了什么。
篮子翻倒了。米撒了一路。
三个忍者为了一个斥候，违抗他们的将军。
还是捡起来吧。要是没人给他送晚饭，我来送。

en: Night. The Temple cells.
Beneath the old wing of the Temple burns a single torch. Behind the bars, someone is awake.
I brought you rice.
…Poisoned?
Just dirt. Your friends knocked it all over the road.
My friends?
Three of them. They wanted to trade me for you.
…Idiots. The Shogun's going to hang them by their thumbs.
Did they hurt you?
No. They had orders not to.
Thanks for the rice. My name's Sora.
I know. They shouted it.
They called me “the blanket boy.” What do you people know about me?
Less than you think. More than we should.
My blanket has the mark you left on the wall stitched into it.
Sora stops eating.
…Six dots around one?
In grey thread. In one corner.
Then it was true. She was right.
Who?
No, kid. If I tell you, you won't believe me. You have to see it.
My little sister is just like you. Questions and more questions. Someday you two will meet.
A dull thud on the roof. Then another.
…No. I told her not to come.
Ren! They've come to break him out! They're on the roof!
zh: 寺院旧翼下只点着一支火把。铁栏后面，有人没睡。
只有点土。你的同伙在路上把它打翻了。
……一群蠢货。将军会把他们吊着大拇指挂起来。
没有。他们奉命不准伤我。
他们叫我“裹毯子的孩子”。你们到底知道我什么？
比你想的少。比我们该知道的多。
我的毯子上绣着你留在墙上的那个印记。
那就是真的了。她说对了。
不行，小子。我说了你也不会信。你得亲眼看见。
我妹妹跟你一样。问个不停。总有一天你们会见面的。
屋顶上一声闷响。接着又一声。
仁！他们来救他了！在屋顶上！

en: The smoke clears. The cells.
The rescuers fled across the roof. They left the prisoner behind.
Your friends abandoned you.
They didn't come to get me out. They came to distract you.
Distract me from what?
From the one who really came. Right now she's fighting your Master Mei in the hallway upstairs.
Listen, there's no time. We didn't come to steal.
**We came to warn you.**
Warn us about what?
What your Abbot keeps down below…
The torch goes out on its own. A cold mist seeps in under the door.
At the cell door stands a white fox. No one saw it come in.
It is not yet time for him to know.
…Yes, my lady.
My lady? You're talking to a fox?
He listens to me. That's more than most men do.
Eat the rice yourself, blanket boy. You'll need it.
Wait! Do you know who stitched my blanket?
When the stone beats, you'll know.
The fox and the prisoner vanish into the mist.
The cell is still shut. Locked. From the outside.
What stone?
zh: 救人的忍者从屋顶逃了。囚犯被留了下来。
他们不是来救我的。是来引开你的。
为了真正要来的那个人。她这会儿正在楼上走廊里跟你们梅师父交手。
听着，没时间了。我们不是来偷东西的。
你们方丈藏在下面的东西……
火把自己熄灭了。一股冰冷的雾从门缝下渗进来。
牢门口站着一只白狐。没有人看见它进来。
还不是让他知道的时候。
大人？你在跟一只狐狸说话？
他肯听我说话。大多数人可做不到。
米饭你自己吃吧，裹毯子的孩子。你会用得上。
等等！你知道是谁绣了我的毯子吗？
等石头跳动时，你就会知道。
白狐和囚犯消失在雾中。
牢门依旧紧闭。上了锁。从外面锁的。

en: Minutes later. The north wall.
They're all over the wall! They're covering someone's escape.
Gon, did you see a fox? Or the prisoner?
What fox? The prisoner's gone! And the cell was still locked!
Ren, if they get over the north wall, they head straight down to the village.
…Hana.
My sister's eight. She sleeps right by the road.
So not one of them gets through. Not one.
Gon. Your arm. You didn't fall.
Later. If we get out of this, I'll tell you.
Focus, Ren! There are a lot of them, and the night is long.
zh: 墙上到处都是！他们在掩护某个人逃跑。
刚，你看见一只狐狸了吗？还是那个囚犯？
什么狐狸？囚犯不见了！牢门还锁着！
仁，要是他们翻过北墙，就会直接下到村子里。
我妹妹才八岁。就睡在路边。
所以一个也别想过去。一个也不行。
刚。你的胳膊。你不是摔的。
以后再说。要是我们能活着过了今晚，我就告诉你。
集中精神，仁！他们人多，夜还长着呢。

en: The ninjas retreat into the forest. The wall falls silent.
Running like rabbits!
Your arm, Gon.
The other night the Abbot woke me. Just me. He sent me to guard the crypt stairs.
He said: “No one goes down. And don't tell anyone. Not even Ren.”
Not even me.
A ninja came. A little one, with a fan. She beat me in three moves.
And before going down, she apologized.
She went down?
All the way to the stone door. Then the bells rang and she left.
That's why I went hunting for the scout. I couldn't come back empty-handed.
Don't tell anyone, Ren.
That you lost?
That I'm scared of what's down there.
“We came to warn you.” “What he keeps down below.” A staircase I'm not allowed to know about.
Tomorrow I'll ask the Abbot. Even if he gets angry.
zh: 忍者们退回林中。寺墙归于寂静。
前几天夜里，方丈把我叫醒。只叫了我一个。他让我去守地穴的阶梯。
他说：“谁也不准下去。也别告诉任何人。连仁也不行。”
来了一个忍者。个子小小的，拿着扇子。三招就把我打败了。
下去之前，她还向我道了歉。
一直到石门前。后来钟声响了，她就走了。
所以我才去抓那个斥候。我不能空着手回来。
“我们是来警告的。”“他藏在下面的东西。”一道不许我知道的阶梯。
明天我去问方丈。就算他会发火。

en: Dawn. The main gate.
The morning mist covers the steps. Someone waits at the gate, alone. He isn't hiding.
The blanket boy.
Why does everyone call me that? Who are you?
Kuro. The one who stays behind so the others make it home.
I hear you surround well. That you brought rice to a prisoner.
A monk feeding a ninja… You don't see that often.
Did they make it? Sora and the one with the fan.
…You know too much for a novice.
And I understand nothing. What do you want from the Temple?
What's ours. The Jade Scroll. Today, or next time.
The Scroll is sacred. No one takes it out of the library.
Have you ever seen it?
Neither have I. Neither of us is defending something we've seen.
Let's at least make the fight worth it.
zh: 晨雾笼罩着台阶。有人独自等在门口。他没有躲藏。
为什么人人都这么叫我？你是谁？
黑。殿后的人，好让其他人能回家。
听说你包围得不错。还给囚犯送过饭。
和尚给忍者送饭……这可不常见。
他们回去了吗？空，还有拿扇子的那个。
……作为一个小沙弥，你知道得太多了。
可我什么都不明白。你们想从寺里得到什么？
属于我们的东西。翡翠卷轴。今天拿不到，就下次。
卷轴是神圣的。谁也不能把它带出藏经阁。
我也没有。我们俩守护的，都是自己没见过的东西。
那至少让这一战值得吧。

en: Well fought. Better than any of mine at your age.
But you understand nothing about what you defend.
Then explain it to me!
Not my place. Sixteen years ago I swore never to tell.
Sixteen years? You were…?
Ask your master who left you on the step. And look him in the eye when he answers.
Wait!
Later. The Abbot's chamber.
Master, the ninjas say they've come to warn us.
They talk about something we keep down below. You had Gon guard the crypt and forbade him to tell me.
Gon talks too much.
And my blanket has the wall's mark stitched into it. Six dots around one.
The Abbot doesn't answer. For the first time in sixteen years, he doesn't look Ren in the eye.
“Look him in the eye when he answers.”
Master. Who left me on the step?
**Forget it.** That is an order.
He's never shouted at me before.
The floor trembles, barely.
Grey dust falls from the ceiling.
Master…?
It isn't dust. It's **ash**.
The same thing he had on his sleeves that night.
It has begun.
Just like the night she placed him in my arms.
zh: 打得好。比我手下任何人在你这年纪时都强。
可你根本不明白自己在守护什么。
轮不到我说。十六年前我发过誓，绝不说出去。
去问你师父，是谁把你放在台阶上的。他回答时，看着他的眼睛。
师父，忍者说他们是来警告的。
他们说我们在下面藏着东西。您让刚守着地穴，还不准他告诉我。
我的毯子上还绣着墙上那个印记。六个点围着一个点。
方丈没有回答。十六年来第一次，他没有看仁的眼睛。
师父。是谁把我放在台阶上的？
跟那天夜里他袖子上的一样。
就像她把他放进我怀里的那一夜。

en: Days later. Outside the Temple, without permission.
Ren slips down the mountain stairs before dawn. No one saw him leave.
If the Abbot won't tell me, I'll find out myself.
Sneaking out, kid? *hic*
Master Tao! Don't tell anyone.
Me? I didn't see a thing. I never see anything. *hic*
I'll come with you.
zh: 天亮前，仁顺着山间石阶溜了下去。没人看见他离开。
既然方丈不肯告诉我，我就自己去查。
我？我什么也没看见。我从来什么都看不见。*嗝*

en: The trail, further on.
Footprints in the mud. Light feet, the kind that don't want to be seen.
They head east. To the old shrine.
Do you know something?
I know how to drink.
The rest I forgot. *hic*
For someone who forgot everything, he reads tracks very well.
zh: 泥里有脚印。脚步很轻，是不想被人看见的那种。
一个什么都忘了的人，看脚印倒是看得很准。

en: The only bridge over the river.
The river roars below. The ninjas block the bridge from end to end.
It will be a long battle, with nowhere to retreat.
Master, will you help me?
I'll wait for you on this side. I have… things to do. *hic*
zh: 河水在下面咆哮。忍者们从头到尾堵住了整座桥。
这一战会很漫长，而且无路可退。
我在这边等你。我还有……事要办。*嗝*

en: The far bank.
I made it!
On the other side of the river, Tao raises his gourd in a toast.
I never doubted you!
Well. A little.
zh: 河的另一边，陶举起酒葫芦遥遥一敬。

en: The abandoned shrine.
Moss, fallen stones, a torii no one tends. And something carved into the rock.
Six stones in a hexagon, around a horned figure.
That's the Temple's symbol…
…and that's the clan's. Together?
No one has looked at those stones in centuries. What's a monk doing here?
And who are you?
Someone who asked the same thing you did.
Show me how you fight and I'll answer.
zh: 青苔，倒下的石块，一座无人照看的鸟居。还有刻在岩石上的东西。
六块石头排成六边形，围着一个长角的身影。
几百年没人看过这些石头了。一个和尚来这里做什么？
一个和你问过同样问题的人。
让我看看你怎么打，我就回答你。

en: I was a monk, you know.
They threw me out for asking what the Jade Scroll says.
The Scroll is sacred. Only the Abbot reads it.
Exactly.
And you never wondered why?
zh: 我以前也是和尚，你知道吗。
他们把我赶出来，只因为我问翡翠卷轴上写着什么。
卷轴是神圣的。只有方丈能读。

en: The forest, at night.
They followed you from the shrine. There are many.
How many?
Among the bamboo, a shadow. Two. Four.
Shinobi slip through any gap.
Then leave no gaps.
zh: 他们从神社一路跟着你。人很多。
竹林间，一道影子。两道。四道。
忍者会从任何缝隙钻进来。

en: A fallen shinobi drops something as he flees: a small scroll tied with red thread.
It has the Shogun's seal.
Read it.
*(reading)* "Bring the Jade Scroll before the new moon."
The new moon is in ten days.
zh: 一个倒下的忍者逃跑时掉了样东西：一卷用红线系着的小卷轴。
*（读着）*“新月之前，带回翡翠卷轴。”

en: The valley. Thick fog.
Nothing stays still in the fog. Ren lost Jubei an hour ago.
Jubei? Jubei!
Follow me, little monk.
You! What are you?
The one who remembers.
Follow me, and don't get lost.
zh: 雾里没有什么是静止的。一个时辰前，仁就跟丢了十兵卫。

en: The edge of the valley.
Tomorrow you will meet someone who asks your same questions.
Who?
Someone from the other side.
The other side… of the valley? Or of the war?
zh: 明天你会遇见一个和你问同样问题的人。
另一边……山谷的另一边？还是战争的另一边？

en: The shrine, at dawn.
Two shadows in the same clearing. Neither moves first.
A monk. Alone. In my forest.
It's not your forest.
You see her too? The white fox.
*(surprised)* Yes.
Then you know something is wrong.
I'll still beat you.
zh: 同一片空地上，两道身影。谁也没有先动。
一个和尚。独自一人。在我的林子里。
你也看得见她？那只白狐。
那你就知道有什么不对劲了。

en: You won. This time.
Your friend said they came to warn us. About what?
I don't know. Neither does my Shogun.
But ask your Abbot **what lies beneath the Temple**.
A smoke bomb. Aya is gone.
Beneath the Temple. Again.
zh: 你们的人说是来警告的。警告什么？
我不知道。我的将军也不知道。
但去问问你的方丈，**寺院底下有什么**。
一颗烟雾弹。绫已经不见了。

en: The Temple. Ren returns after a week.
The incense still burns, as always. But there are guards where there never were.
Ren! Where have you been?
Outside. Learning things.
The Abbot was furious. He locked the library.
He locked the library?
And he put guards on the crypt. Something's going on.
Let's spar, like before. I missed you.
zh: 寺院。仁在一周后回来了。
香火依旧燃着，一如往常。但以前从没有守卫的地方，如今站着守卫。
方丈大发雷霆。他把藏经阁锁上了。
还在地穴派了守卫。出事了。
我们打一场吧，像以前一样。我想你了。

en: You fight differently.
More… like them.
Gon, do you know what's in the crypt?
No one goes down there.
Only Tao.
zh: 刚，你知道地穴里有什么吗？

en: The novices' dormitory.
It's night, and the youngest ones aren't sleeping. They sit together, eyes wide open.
Brother Ren… we dream of fire.
All of you?
All of us. The same dream.
A horned thing beneath our feet.
They're just dreams. Come on, training.
zh: 夜里，最小的几个都没睡。他们挤在一起，眼睛睁得大大的。
一个长角的东西，在我们脚底下。

en: At last the novices fall asleep, exhausted.
A horned figure.
Like in the carvings at the shrine.
zh: 小沙弥们终于累得睡着了。
就像神社石刻上的那样。

en: Midnight. The library.
Ren forces the door. The shelves smell of dust and wax.
Someone stands by the altar. Waiting for him.
I knew you would come.
I want to read the Scroll.
It isn't here.
And if it were, you'd have to get past me first.
zh: 仁撬开了门。书架上满是灰尘和蜡的气味。
祭坛旁有人。一直在等他。
就算在，你也得先过我这一关。

en: There is a seal, Ren. Beneath the Temple.
It is breaking.
And the Abbot?
He says he can renew it alone. That no one else needs to know.
Do you believe him?
zh: 有一道封印，仁。在寺院底下。
他说他能独自重修封印。说别人不必知道。

en: Dawn. The courtyard covered in ash.
Last night's tremor split the courtyard. Grey smoke rises from the crack.
Ninjas on the wall! They're using the chaos!
It's not their fault!
It's coming from below!
zh: 昨夜的震动在庭院裂开一道缝。灰色的烟从里面冒出来。
墙上有忍者！他们想趁乱进来！

en: The ninjas withdraw. The ash keeps falling, like dirty snow.
Through the ash, for a moment, Ren sees two red eyes.
…Did you see that?
See what?
zh: 忍者们撤退了。灰烬还在落，像脏了的雪。
灰烬之中，有那么一瞬，仁看见了两只红眼。

en: The Abbot's hall.
The tremors are the clan's doing.
Kage wants the Scroll to free something he doesn't understand.
Master, Mei said that…
Mei talks too much.
Ren, you will go to the clan's pagoda. You will defeat Kage.
It is the only way to protect the Temple.
Me?
You are the best I have.
zh: 地震是忍者一族搞的鬼。
影想要卷轴，去释放一个他根本不懂的东西。
仁，你去忍者的宝塔。去打败影。
这是保护寺院唯一的办法。

en: The corridor, on the way out.
*(quietly)* Ren. Don't go.
It's an order from the Abbot.
Orders can be wrong too.
The gate, at night.
Ren leaves with nothing but the clothes on his back. On the last step, someone blocks his way.
To the pagoda, kid? *hic*
Let me pass, master.
The old man is using you.
If you fight Kage, no one will be left for what's coming.
What's coming?
For once, Tao doesn't seem drunk.
Beat me and I'll let you go. Lose and you stay.
zh: 仁只身出发。在最后一级台阶上，有人拦住了他。
你要是跟影打，就没人能对付接下来的东西了。
这一次，陶看起来一点也不醉。
赢了我，我就放你走。输了，你就留下。

en: Bah.
You're as stubborn as Daishin.
Who is Daishin?
Ask Kage. If he lets you talk. *hic*
Ren goes down the mountain. Behind him, the Temple bell stays silent.
zh: 去问影吧。如果他肯让你开口的话。*嗝*
仁走下山去。在他身后，寺院的钟没有响。

en: The clan's pagoda. Five floors.
Ren arrives alone. The door is open, as if they were expecting him.
The Shogun said the Abbot's boy would come.
That he should climb, if he can.
zh: 仁独自到来。大门敞开着，好像早就在等他。
将军说过，方丈的那个小子会来。
让他上来，如果他有本事的话。

en: One floor.
Four to go.
Second floor. The floor of fans.
Red lanterns, curtains that move without wind. And behind every curtain, an open fan.
Aya told us about you. She said you ask a lot of questions.
Is she here?
She's gone. To the Temple.
While you climb up, she goes down.
zh: 红灯笼，无风自动的帘幕。每道帘幕后，都有一把张开的扇子。
绫提起过你。她说你问题很多。
你往上爬的时候，她正往下走。

en: Aya at the Temple…
And the Abbot, alone?
Third floor. The rafters.
The Tengu leap from beam to beam. They never touch the floor.
Come down and fight!
Two paths, one same night.
Hurry, little monk.
zh: 天狗在梁与梁之间跳跃。从不落地。

en: Wait! What's happening at the Temple?
What had to happen.
From the railing, the Temple can be seen far away. Above it, a red light that isn't the dawn.
zh: 从栏杆望去，能看见远处的寺院。寺院上空，有一道不是晨光的红光。

en: Fourth floor.
I told you we'd meet again.
I'm not here to steal anything.
I've come to talk to your Shogun.
No one talks to the Shogun without going through me.
zh: 我是来找你们将军谈的。
不过我这一关，谁也别想见将军。

en: Go up.
But when he tells you the truth, you'll wish you hadn't heard it.
zh: 但等他告诉你真相，你会宁愿自己没听过。

en: The last door.
Behind the door, a single breath. Slow.
The Abbot told me to defeat him.
Tao told me to listen to him.
No one enters.
zh: 门后，只有一个人的呼吸。缓慢。

en: The elite guard falls. The door opens by itself.
*(from inside)* Come in, disciple of Hōshin.
zh: 精锐守卫倒下了。门自己开了。

en: The top of the pagoda.
Wind. The moon over the mountains. And a man in black armor who doesn't turn around.
Hōshin sent you to kill me.
To defeat you.
To him it's the same thing.
Very well. Surround me if you can.
zh: 风。群山上的月亮。还有一个身穿黑甲、没有回头的男人。

en: …You won.
Now listen, because no one else will tell you.
Beneath your Temple sleeps the Ash Oni. It was sealed three hundred years ago.
Your Abbot knows the seal is breaking. He has known for years.
Then he'll renew it.
He can't. **Not alone.**
The clan always knew: the Scroll is one half of our pact.
What pact?
That I don't know. That's why I wanted it.
My master… lied to me.
In the distance, above the Temple, a column of ash rises.
zh: 现在听着，因为没人会告诉你。
你的寺院底下沉睡着灰烬鬼。它在三百年前被封印。
你的方丈知道封印正在破碎。他早就知道了。
他做不到。**一个人做不到。**
忍者一直都知道：卷轴是我们盟约的一半。
这我不知道。所以我才想要它。
远处，寺院上空，升起一道灰烬之柱。

en: The clan's pagoda. Night.
High on the mountain, the clan's red lanterns never go out.
Tonight, a fifteen-year-old girl kneels before the Shogun. It's her first mission.
The Jade Scroll belongs to us.
The monks stole it centuries ago.
What does the Scroll say, my lord?
That doesn't matter. What matters is that it comes home.
Always the same answer.
Tonight you climb the wall for the first time. Kuro will guide you. Your brother goes with you.
Not to steal. Not yet. I want to know how many guards they have, and where.
One more thing.
If you see a young disciple, short-haired, who plays the board alone… do him no harm.
Why, my lord?
Because I say so.
Who is he?
An old debt. The clan's, not mine.
Aya grew up in the pagoda. Her grandmother Kiku taught her the board before she could walk.
Kiku died last winter. Her last words were a phrase no one understood.
“When the stone beats, surround again.”
What stone, Grandma?
Later. The Temple wall.
Nervous, little sister?
Shut up, Sora.
Your knees are shaking. Mine used to shake too.
Yours still do.
Both of you. Quiet. The wall guard.
Get past him without a sound. If he shouts, the mission's over.
Like a shadow.
zh: 高山之上，一族的红灯笼永不熄灭。
今夜，一个十五岁的少女跪在将军面前。这是她的第一个任务。
几百年前，和尚们偷走了它。
那不重要。重要的是让它回家。
今晚你第一次上墙。黑会带你。你哥哥也跟你们一起去。
不是去偷。还不是时候。我要知道他们有多少守卫，都在哪里。
要是看见一个短发的年轻弟子，独自下棋……别伤他。
一笔旧债。一族的，不是我的。
绫在宝塔长大。她还没学会走路，奶奶菊就教她下棋了。
菊去年冬天过世了。她留下的最后一句话，没人听得懂。
你的膝盖在抖。我以前也抖。
你们两个。安静。墙上的守卫。
无声无息地过去。他一喊，任务就结束了。

en: The guard sleeps against the wall. He never even knew he lost.
We're in.
Good. First test, passed.
I'll take the north wing. I've got something to do.
What thing? Kuro didn't say anything about…
Sora.
Big brother stuff. I'll be back before the roosters crow.
You're not going to stop him?
For three moons your brother has been slipping out at night without permission. If I stop him, I'll never know where he goes.
If I let him go, someday he'll tell me.
Every time he says “big brother stuff,” he's lying.
And he's got charcoal in his pocket. What does a scout need charcoal for?
zh: 守卫靠着墙睡着了。连自己输了都不知道。
我去北翼。我有点事要办。
哥哥的事。鸡叫之前我就回来。
三个月来，你哥哥夜夜擅自外出。我要是拦他，就永远不知道他去哪儿。
放他去，总有一天他会告诉我。
他每次说“哥哥的事”，都是在撒谎。
而且他兜里揣着木炭。一个斥候要木炭做什么？

en: The novices' yard.
A low pavilion, full of small mats. Someone left a lantern burning.
A shadow! Alarm!
They're kids.
They're the age I was when they put a tantō in my hand.
Don't let them shout any louder. Don't hurt anyone.
He said that fast. Like he cared.
We don't know Jade Meditation yet, but we're not afraid of you!
Then we play without tricks. If I win, you go back to sleep.
And if we win?
I'll sound the alarm myself. For you.
zh: 一座低矮的亭舍，铺满小小的草席。有人留了一盏灯没灭。
我被塞进一把短刀的时候，也就他们这么大。
别让他们喊得更大声。谁也别伤。
他说得很快。像是很在乎。
我们还不会翡翠冥想，可我们不怕你们！
那就不用花招。我赢了，你们就回去睡觉。

en: The novices return to their mats. One falls asleep hugging a wooden piece.
Kuro… why do we surround?
They surround too. The monks, the kids, us. All the same.
Because that's how you win.
But why **like this**? There are a thousand ways to win a fight.
When I asked my master that, he hit me with a cane.
And are you going to hit me?
No. But I'm not going to answer you either.
You ask too many questions, Aya. Just like your grandmother.
You knew Kiku when she was young?
She taught me to surround. And once, in the middle of a game, she started to cry.
Why?
She said the board was incomplete. That it was missing a hand.
A hand?
zh: 小沙弥们回到草席上。有一个抱着木棋子睡着了。
他们也包围。和尚、孩子、我们。全都一样。
可为什么**偏偏这样**？打赢一场架有上千种办法。
我问我师父这个问题的时候，他拿藤条抽了我。
不打。但我也不会回答你。
你问题太多了，绫。跟你奶奶一样。
是她教我包围的。有一次，棋下到一半，她哭了起来。
她说棋盘不完整。说少了一只手。

en: The inner courtyard.
A master makes his rounds by the incense burner. He coughs. He doesn't look up.
They never look up.
That's no ordinary guard. That's a Temple master.
On his next round he'll see us. We drop on him, now.
And Sora? He should be back by now.
Your brother can take care of himself. You worry about not falling off the roof.
Aya drops on the master on watch before he can react. Three shadows surround him.
zh: 一位师父在香炉旁巡视。他咳了几声。没有抬头。
那可不是普通守卫。是寺里的师父。
下一圈他就会看见我们。得马上扑下去。
你哥哥能照顾好自己。你管好自己别从屋顶摔下去。
守夜的师父还没反应过来，绫已扑到他身上。三道黑影将他围住。

en: From the rooftop, Aya sees something odd: no one is guarding the library.
Every torch surrounds a **staircase** leading down beneath the Temple. And a single guard watches it, with a staff.
The Shogun said the Scroll is in the library.
Then… what are they guarding down there, so afraid?
No. Don't even think about it. The mission is to count guards, not go down stairs.
You saw it too. They put more guards on a hole than on the Scroll.
Ten minutes. I'll count the guards in the west wing. If you're not back, I'm coming for you.
He didn't say no.
zh: 绫在屋顶上看见一件怪事：藏经阁无人看守。
所有火把都围着一道通往寺院地下的**阶梯**。只有一个拿棍的守卫看着。
将军说卷轴在藏经阁里。
那么……他们这么害怕，下面守的到底是什么？
不行。想都别想。任务是数守卫，不是下阶梯。
你也看见了。他们守一个洞的人比守卷轴的还多。
十分钟。我去数西翼的守卫。你要是没回来，我就去找你。

en: The crypt entrance.
A stone mouth in the ground. Below, the torches burn without flickering. A summer heat rises from it.
Halt! No one goes down.
What's down there?
I don't know.
The Abbot woke only me and said no one goes down. That's enough for me.
You're defending something you don't even know?
And you? Do you know what you came to steal?
Thought so.
My sister sleeps in the village below. She's eight. If you get through, you get through her.
We didn't come for any village.
That's what everyone who comes at night says.
He's scared. Not of me. Of what's behind him.
I have someone too. And I'm not going back without knowing.
zh: 地上张着一张石头的嘴。下面的火把燃得纹丝不动。一股夏日般的热气往上涌。
方丈只叫醒了我，说谁也不准下去。对我来说这就够了。
你守着一个连是什么都不知道的东西？
那你呢？你知道自己来偷什么吗？
我妹妹睡在山下的村子里。她才八岁。你们要是过去了，就是冲着她去的。
我们不是冲着村子来的。
他在害怕。不是怕我。是怕他身后的东西。
我也有要守护的人。不弄清楚，我不回去。

en: Gon drops onto the steps. He isn't hurt. He's furious.
Sorry.
Sorry? You beat me and say sorry?
I twisted your arm. I didn't mean to.
Aya goes down to the bottom of the stairs. There's a stone door, shut with six bolts.
The stone is **warm**. And it beats, slowly.
…Like a heart.
“When the stone beats, surround again.”
Grandma… is this what we prayed to?
Above, the bells begin to ring.
zh: 刚一屁股坐在台阶上。他没受伤。他气坏了。
对不起？你打赢了我还说对不起？
我扭伤了你的胳膊。我不是故意的。
绫一直走到阶梯底部。那里有一扇石门，上了六道门闩。
石头是**温热的**。还在缓缓跳动。
奶奶……我们祈祷的，就是这个吗？

en: Bells. The whole Temple wakes.
They've seen us! We're leaving.
Kuro, there's a stone door down there. It's hot. It beats!
Later.
It beats, Kuro! Like something alive.
For an instant, the smoke jonin looks frightened.
I said later. Where's your brother?
He didn't come back. We can't leave without Sora!
Sora knows the way. We have to reach the north wall before the monks.
Now, Aya! There are a lot of them, and they'll chase us till dawn.
zh: 黑，下面有一扇石门。是热的。还在跳！
有那么一瞬间，烟之上忍似乎有些害怕。
我说了以后再说。你哥哥呢？
空认得路。我们得赶在和尚们之前到北墙。
快走，绫！他们人多，会一直追到天亮。

en: The forest, at dawn.
They escaped. They wait among the bamboo until the sun comes up. Sora doesn't show.
Something happened to him.
Kuro. They caught him. A big monk, with a bandaged arm.
The one on the stairs. The one I left like that.
He was coming back from the north wing. His hands were black with charcoal.
We're going back for him.
The Shogun will say no. A scout isn't worth a mission.
He's not a scout. He's my brother.
I know.
That's why I'm telling you and not the Shogun: the roof over the cells is loose.
Some of ours are thinking something else. A trade.
What trade?
The Abbot's disciple goes down to the village alone every afternoon.
**No.** The Shogun was clear.
The disciple no one's allowed to hurt…
Who is that boy, that even the Shogun protects him?
zh: 他们逃出来了。在竹林里一直等到太阳升起。空没有出现。
黑。他被抓了。是个大块头和尚，胳膊上缠着绷带。
是守阶梯的那个。是我把他弄成那样的。
他是从北翼回来的。两手都被木炭染黑了。
将军会说不行。一个斥候不值得一次任务。
他不是斥候。他是我哥哥。
所以我告诉你，而不是告诉将军：牢房的屋顶不牢靠。
我们有些人另有打算。交换。
方丈的弟子每天下午都独自下山去村里。
那个少年到底是谁，连将军都要护着他？

en: The next night. The cells.
Two of her people pound on the roof of the old wing to distract the monks. Aya goes in alone, another way.
While they fight up there, I go down. Hold on, Sora.
In the cell corridor, someone waits for her, seated on the floor, eyes closed.
You came back for your brother. That says something good about you.
How do you know he's my brother?
He talks about you all the time. The sister who asks and asks.
He talks in his sleep, too. He says “grandma,” and he says “stone.”
You went down last night, didn't you? All the way to the door.
Do you know what's there?
I know I shouldn't. And that the one who knows everything won't share it.
I don't need your permission. I need my brother.
No. You need to get past me.
zh: 两个同伴敲打旧翼的屋顶，引开和尚们。绫独自从另一边潜入。
趁他们在上面打，我下去。撑住，空。
牢房走廊里，有人坐在地上等她，双眼紧闭。
你回来救你哥哥。这说明你心地不坏。
您怎么知道他是我哥哥？
他整天都在说你。说那个问个不停的妹妹。
他还说梦话。说“奶奶”，说“石头”。
昨晚你下去了，对吧？一直到那扇门前。
我知道我不该知道。也知道那个什么都知道的人，不肯说出来。
我不需要您的允许。我需要我哥哥。
不。你需要先过我这一关。

en: …Enough.
You give up?
I'm tired. It's not the same thing.
Go. And take your brother, if you find him.
Why are you letting me go?
Because something bigger than this war is coming. And the less blood between us, the better.
Tell your Shogun that not all of us in the Temple are blind.
The cell.
Sora's cell is locked. And empty.
Sora…?
In the straw lies a half-eaten plate of rice. With dirt in it.
Someone brought him food. A monk.
The crypt staircase.
Aya. Over here.
Sora! How did you get out?
I didn't get out. I was taken out.
What you came looking for is not what you think, granddaughter of Kiku.
You knew my grandmother?
I brought her messages for forty years. Now I bring them to your brother.
Sora…?
I was going to tell you. The mark on the wall, the nights out… It's her. She asks me to warn the Temple.
Warn them of what?
That the stone beats. And no one wants to listen.
Beneath Aya's feet, the stone **beats** once more. Stronger. Grey dust falls from the ceiling.
Grey. Like Grandma's cough.
zh: 走吧。找得到你哥哥的话，就带他走。
因为有比这场战争更大的东西要来了。我们之间流的血越少越好。
告诉你们将军，寺里不是每个人都瞎了眼。
空的牢房锁着。里面空无一人。
稻草上留着一碗吃了一半的米饭。沾着土。
有人给他送过饭。一个和尚。
不是我出来的。是有人带我出来的。
你要找的东西，不是你想的那样，菊的孙女。
我给她送了四十年的信。如今送给你哥哥。
我本来要告诉你的。墙上的印记，夜里偷偷外出……都是她。她让我去警告寺院。
石头在跳动。却没有人愿意听。
绫脚下的石头又**跳动**了一次。更强了。灰色的尘从顶上落下。

en: The pagoda.
My lord, the crypt door beats.
There is something alive beneath the Temple.
Monks' superstitions.
I touched it myself.
Kuro. Train her. She is distracted.
Yes, my lord.
You fight with anger.
I fight with questions.
Questions don't win battles.
Not yet.
The Temple's zen garden.
Sand raked into perfect circles. No one ever steps on it.
Until today.
The monks have sealed off the garden. Break through before more arrive.
zh: 耙成完美圆圈的白沙。从来没人踩过。
和尚们封锁了庭园。得在更多人赶来之前杀出一条路。

en: In the center of the garden, six stones form a hexagon.
One of them is cracked.
Six stones…
Like the board.
zh: 庭园中央，六块石头围成一个六边形。

en: The garden pass.
The Marble Tigers guard the way. They push everything in their path.
Big, slow and stubborn.
Like the monks.
zh: 石虎把守通道。挡路的一切都会被推开。

en: Six stones, two hands.
Do you remember the song, kunoichi?
What song?
The one your clan stopped singing.
zh: 你还记得那首歌吗，女忍？
你们一族不再唱的那首。

en: A mountain road.
A ninja who looks at old stones. Strange.
You know them?
I was a monk. I know what the Temple keeps quiet.
Beat me and I'll tell you what the clan forgot.
zh: 一个盯着老石头看的忍者。真稀奇。
我以前是和尚。我知道寺院隐瞒了什么。
赢了我，我就告诉你忍者一族忘了什么。

en: Your clan says the Scroll is theirs. They're not lying.
But they don't remember **why** either.
Ask your Shogun what the Scroll says.
I already asked. He doesn't know.
Then no one in this war knows what they're fighting for.
zh: 你们一族说卷轴是他们的。他们没说谎。
但他们也不记得**为什么**。
去问你的将军，卷轴上写着什么。
那这场战争里，就没有一个人知道自己为何而战。

en: The forest, at night.
Smoke bombs everywhere. Don't let any monk know where you are.
Now.
Tomorrow you will meet someone who asks your same questions.
zh: 烟雾弹四起。别让任何僧人知道你在哪。
明天你会遇见一个和你问同样问题的人。

en: Fox… who are you?
The one who remembers what you all forgot.
zh: 记得你们所遗忘之事的那一个。

en: The shrine, at dawn.
Two shadows in the same clearing. Neither moves first.
A monk. Alone. In my forest.
It's not your forest.
You see her too? The white fox.
*(surprised)* Yes.
Then you know something is wrong.
I'll still beat you.
zh: 同一片空地上，两道身影。谁也没有先动。
一个和尚。独自一人。在我的林子里。
你也看得见她？那只白狐。
那你就知道有什么不对劲了。

en: You won. This time.
Your comrade said you came to warn us. About what?
I don't know. Neither does my Shogun.
But ask your Abbot **what lies beneath the Temple**.
My master never lies.
Then it won't be hard to ask him.
zh: 你的同伴说你们是来警告的。警告什么？
我不知道。我的将军也不知道。
但去问问你的方丈，**寺院底下有什么**。

en: Night. Inside the Temple.
Aya slips in once more.
This time she isn't looking for the library. She's looking for the staircase.
New guards. Lots of them.
zh: 这一次她找的不是藏经阁。她找的是那道阶梯。

en: The crypt staircase.
Steps that go down, and down.
…It's hot.
With every step, the air grows hotter.
zh: 每走一步，空气就更热一分。

en: The crypt.
An enormous hall. On the floor, six stones in a hexagon around a crack.
Three of the stones are cracked. Ash seeps out of them.
This is a seal.
zh: 一座巨大的石厅。地上，六块石头排成六边形，围着一道裂缝。
其中三块石头已经裂开。灰烬从裂缝中渗出。

en: From the crack rises a voice, like embers.
…Kagerō…
Who is Kagerō?
zh: 裂缝中升起一个声音，如同余烬。

en: The ash takes shape. Grey pieces, with no owner, move on their own.
What is this?!
zh: 灰烬聚成了形。灰色的棋子，没有主人，自己在动。

en: The ash pieces crumble.
But they gather again. More slowly.
They can't be defeated. Only held back.
zh: 但它们又聚拢起来。更慢了。
打不赢它们。只能拦住它们。

en: A ninja in my crypt. *hic*
That hasn't happened in three hundred years.
Are you going to call the guards?
No. We're going to play.
If you beat me, I'll tell you a story.
zh: 一个忍者，跑进了我的地穴。*嗝*
你要是赢了，我就给你讲个故事。

en: Once upon a time there was a monk, Daishin…
…and a ninja, Kagerō.
They surrounded a demon with six stones. Together. Both hands.
A monk and a ninja… together?
That's what the Temple erased. And what your clan forgot. *hic*
zh: 从前有一个和尚，叫大心……
他们用六块石头包围了一个恶鬼。一起。两只手。
一个和尚和一个忍者……一起？
这就是寺院抹去的。也是你的族人遗忘的。*嗝*

en: The crypt, before dawn.
And now run.
The Abbot comes down every night to look at the cracks.
Footsteps on the stairs.
zh: 方丈每天夜里都会下来看那些裂缝。

en: Outside. First light.
Aya leaves the Temple at first light.
Her hands are shaking.
zh: 绫在第一缕晨光中离开了寺院。

en: The pagoda.
My lord, the Scroll is not a treasure. It's a ritual.
A seal. It needs the Temple and the clan.
A drunken monk's tales.
Kuro will go to the Temple tonight and take the Scroll by force.
If you do that, you'll break the seal.
Then step aside, Aya.
zh: 主上，卷轴不是宝物。是一场仪式。
一道封印。它需要寺院，也需要我们一族。
今夜黑会去寺院，用武力夺回卷轴。
你们这么做，封印就会破。

en: …You beat me.
Then you go. But bring it back.
*(from the shadows)* Bring me the Scroll, Aya. Or don't come back.
zh: 那就你去吧。但要把它带回来。
*（从暗处）*把卷轴带给我，绫。否则别回来。

en: The last night before the new moon.
The Temple is emptier than ever. They say the Abbot's disciple went to the pagoda.
Ren and me.
Each of us in the other's house.
zh: 寺院比任何时候都空。听说方丈的弟子去了宝塔。

en: The library is in sight.
The library doors.
The Marble Tigers guard the library. They push everything in their path.
You again.
zh: 石虎守着藏经阁。挡路的一切都会被推开。

en: The ground shakes.
The lamps go out on their own.
It's waking up.
I came to ask you something.
Are you going to fight me again?
Yes. To know if you're ready.
If you read it, there's no turning back.
zh: 是。看看你准备好了没有。
一旦读了，就再也回不了头。

en: You're ready.
I'll distract the ones at the door.
A monk helping a ninja. Like in Tao's story.
zh: 一个和尚帮一个忍者。就像陶讲的故事。

en: You again. Ren isn't here to defend you.
I didn't come for him.
Too bad for you.
zh: 又是你。仁不在，没人护着你。

en: Why don't you finish me?
Because you're not my enemy.
None of you are.
I let you go once.
And not now.
Now I can't.
The Abbot is inside.
*(stepping aside)* Let someone read it. At last.
The library. The Jade Scroll on the altar.
No one has beaten me in forty years.
There's a first time for everything.
If you beat me, read it.
And you will understand why I kept silent.
zh: 藏经阁。翡翠卷轴放在祭坛上。
你会明白我为什么一直沉默。

en: Aya unrolls the Jade Scroll.
*(reading)* "Six stones around. One hand of the Temple, one hand of the Shadow. If one is missing, the seal will not close."
…It's not a weapon. It's a ritual. And it needs both of us.
I know. That's why I never said it.
I would rather break alone than ask the clan for help.
The ground splits open beneath the courtyard. A column of ash rises to the sky.
I have the Scroll.
But alone, it's useless.
zh: *（读着）*“六石环绕。寺院一手，暗影一手。缺其一，封印不合。”
……这不是武器。是仪式。而且需要我们两边。
我知道。所以我从未说出口。
我宁愿独自崩溃，也不愿向忍者求助。
庭院底下的大地裂开。一道灰烬之柱冲上天空。
但只有我一个人，它毫无用处。

en: The same night.
At the top of the pagoda, Ren defeated Kage.
In the library, Aya defeated the Abbot. At the same hour.
Beneath the Temple, the last stone splits.
**At last. Fighting each other, as always.**
The Temple courtyard, in grey flames.
Master Tao! What is that?
What your Abbot didn't want to tell you.
A monk. Just one.
Surround it, kid. Now!
zh: 藏经阁中，绫击败了方丈。同一时刻。
寺院底下，最后一块石头裂开了。
寺院庭院，燃着灰色的火焰。
你的方丈不肯告诉你的东西。

en: The Oni retreats into the crack.
But it doesn't close.
Surrounding it stops it.
**It doesn't seal it.**
The stone garden, split in two.
Kuro! Help me!
That thing came from beneath the Temple!
I know. Let's surround it.
zh: 那东西是从寺院底下出来的！

en: The Oni retreats again. Bigger.
One hand alone is not enough.
It never was.
The courtyard. Ren and Aya, face to face.
Kage told me half.
The Scroll tells the other.
One hand of the Temple and one of the Shadow.
Then… together.
*(taking human form)* Like Daishin and Kagerō.
I was the promise they made to each other.
And I was fading.
zh: 灰烬鬼又退了回去。变得更大了。
我是他们彼此许下的诺言。

en: *(wounded, arriving)* Ren… forgive me.
*(arriving over the wall)* Aya. Do what the Scroll says.
Six stones. Two hands.
Now.
Six stones light up green and red.
The crack closes.
The Oni dies out like an ember in the rain.
A week later.
The seal will hold for another three hundred years.
If we don't forget again.
Then let's not forget.
One duel a year. Temple against clan.
On the board.
And so began the **duels of honor**: monks and ninjas, facing each other so they never forget how to surround a demon.
Until the next crack.
zh: 六块石头亮起绿光与红光。
灰烬鬼如雨中的余烬般熄灭。
每年一场对决。寺院对忍者。
**荣誉之战**就此开始：僧人与忍者彼此对弈，永远记得如何包围恶鬼。
